_metadata.description: Durable registry of trusted Vrooli nodes with OS/arch/version/endpoint/capabilities; register, list, inspect, revoke.

requirements.title: Node Registry & Durable Identity
requirements.description: An owner can register, list, inspect, and revoke trusted Vrooli nodes. Each node has a durable, long-lived identity record (stable id, OS, architecture, current Vrooli revision, reachable endpoint, self-reported capabilities, permission scopes) — persistent infrastructure, distinct from device-sync-hub's ephemeral sync-peer grants.

validation.notes: Registry CRUD persists durable node records; revoke removes the node and invalidates its credentials atomically.
CLI register/list/info/revoke round-trip against the API with --json proto-shaped output.
A node survives control-plane restart and reappears with its OS/arch/version/scopes intact.
